name: The Missing Diplomat
summary: In Dustwallow Marsh, you must defeat Private Hendel. Archmage Tervosh then has him taken to Theramore for questioning as the search for the King continues.

sections.title: A Questioning in Theramore
sections.body: The search for the King remains unsettled, and Private Hendel is to be brought to Theramore for questioning. You are asked to defeat him in Dustwallow Marsh. Afterward, Lady Proudmoore is waiting to hear from you, and Hendel's questioning may help them search for the King.

faq.answer: Private Hendel is the man you are asked to defeat in Dustwallow Marsh and take to Theramore for questioning.

faq.q: Why is Hendel being taken to Theramore?
faq.answer: Hendel is to be questioned in Theramore as people search for the King.
Lady Proudmoore is the person who would like to thank you for your help.
The search for the King is ongoing.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Missing Diplomat
